title: Age at pollination modifies relative male and female reproductive success in a monoecious fig tree
screening_reason: Experimental one-sided pollinator-arrival delay, same-syconium mixed pollination/oviposition biology, and final seed output with recoverable mean/SD/n allow a strict quantitative effect.
notes: Ficus curtipes × Eupristina sp.; first quantitatively closed mixed strict-H1 programme. Reconstructed log seed-count slope per day mismatch from all eight source age groups.

title: Costs of inflorescence longevity for an Asian fig tree and its pollinator
screening_reason: Experimental pollinator-arrival delay and final female seed production are quantitatively identified, but Ficus semicordata is dioecious: female syconia do not rear pollinator offspring, so the seed outcome contains the pollination-benefit channel without the nursery cost in the same reproductive unit.
notes: Ficus semicordata × Ceratosolen gravelyi. Source Poisson female seed-count slope beta=-0.12±0.002/day stored in mixed_channel_effects.csv; excluded from mixed net H1.
